faces.name: Court Hussar
faces.oracleText:
Vigilance
When this creature enters, look at the top three cards of your library, then put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
When this creature enters, sacrifice it unless {W} was spent to cast it.

faces.name: Courtly Provocateur
faces.oracleText:
{T}: Target creature attacks this turn if able.
{T}: Target creature blocks this turn if able.

faces.name: Court of Ambition
faces.oracleText:
When this enchantment enters, you become the monarch.
At the beginning of your upkeep, each opponent loses 3 life unless they discard a card. If you're the monarch, instead each opponent loses 6 life unless they discard two cards.

faces.name: Court of Ardenvale
faces.oracleText:
When this enchantment enters, you become the monarch.
At the beginning of your upkeep, return target permanent card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to your hand. If you're the monarch, return that permanent card to the battlefield instead.

faces.name: Court of Bounty
faces.oracleText:
When this enchantment enters, you become the monarch.
At the beginning of your upkeep, you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield. If you're the monarch, instead you may put a creature or land card from your hand onto the battlefield.

faces.name: Court of Cunning
faces.oracleText:
When this enchantment enters, you become the monarch.
At the beginning of your upkeep, any number of target players each mill two cards. If you're the monarch, each of those players mills ten cards instead. (To mill a card, a player puts the top card of their library into their graveyard.)

faces.name: Court of Embereth
faces.oracleText:
When this enchantment enters, you become the monarch.
At the beginning of your upkeep, create a 3/1 red Knight creature token. Then if you're the monarch, this enchantment deals X damage to each opponent, where X is the number of creatures you control.

faces.name: Court of Garenbrig
faces.oracleText:
When this enchantment enters, you become the monarch.
At the beginning of your upkeep, distribute two +1/+1 counters among up to two target creatures. Then if you're the monarch, double the number of +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
